questions: Did this walking problem begin suddenly, within minutes or hours?
Has the walking difficulty been steadily worsening over days or weeks?
Were you able to walk normally before this episode?
Have you had a recent fall or nearly fallen?
Do you feel that one side of your body is weaker than the other?
Do you have new numbness or loss of sensation in either leg?
Do your legs feel stiff or unusually difficult to move?
Do your feet ever feel stuck to the floor when you try to start walking or turn?
Do you have trouble coordinating your legs or feel as though you are veering?
Do you feel dizzy or as though the room is spinning when you walk?
Do you have double vision, slurred speech, facial drooping, or trouble swallowing?
Have you had a new severe headache?
Have you lost consciousness or had a seizure?
Do you have back pain or pain radiating into either leg?
Do you have new difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?
Do you have numbness around the groin or inner thighs?
Have you noticed a tremor, slowed movements, or reduced arm swing?
Have you had problems with memory, attention, or thinking recently?
Have you recently developed urinary urgency or incontinence?
Have you had a recent infection, fever, vaccination, head injury, or other illness?
Have you started, stopped, or changed the dose of any medication recently?
Have you taken any sedatives, antihistamines, antipsychotics, anti-nausea medicines, or recreational drugs recently?
Have you consumed substantially more alcohol than usual recently?
Have you ever had similar episodes before?
Do your walking symptoms improve when you are distracted or when nobody is watching you?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Functional neurological symptom disorder with functional gait disorder (conversion-related gait disturbance), without demonstrable structural, metabolic, peripheral nerve, or medication-induced cause

ALTERNATIVE 1: Early neurodegenerative parkinsonian gait disorder

ALTERNATIVE 2: Functional or factitious/malingered gait disturbance

ALTERNATIVE 3: Medication-related gait impairment from an unidentified recent exposure
